exact_delta: Remove UTF-8 BOM from first line; all remaining bytes are ASCII
File.Replace third argument changes from $null to [NullString]::Value only
rationale: PowerShell 5.1 converts untyped $null to an empty string when binding a string parameter. [NullString]::Value supplies a true null string to the .NET File.Replace backup-path parameter, preserving the intent to discard the replaced receipt without a backup file. This keeps same-directory atomic File.Replace, rather than replacing it with deletion or non-atomic overwrite. ASCII-only content has identical script characters under Windows PowerShell default decoding with or without a UTF-8 BOM.
